kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "It was not until Ngozi got to Lagos that she realized she had forgotten her certificates at home."
options: Ngozi realized she had forgotten her certificates before she left for Lagos.
Ngozi forgot her certificates only after she got to Lagos.
Ngozi did not realize she had forgotten her certificates until she arrived in Lagos.
Ngozi never forgot her certificates at home.
kept.explanation: The phrase 'not until... that' shows the realization only happened when Ngozi got to Lagos, not before. So she discovered her mistake after arriving, not before leaving.
kept.pidgin: Di phrase 'not until... that' mean say na when Ngozi reach Lagos she come notice say she forget her certificates. E no be say she don already know before she travel.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "Chidi is yet to finish his assignment."
options: Chidi has finished his assignment already.
Chidi has not finished his assignment.
Chidi refused to do his assignment.
Chidi will never finish his assignment.
kept.explanation: 'Yet to finish' means the action has not happened at the time of speaking. It simply means Chidi has not completed the assignment, with no suggestion of refusal or permanence.
kept.pidgin: 'Yet to finish' mean say di work never complete as dem dey talk am. E just mean Chidi never finish di assignment, no be say e refuse to do am.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "Mr. Okafor is not unaware of the problems facing his business."
options: Mr. Okafor does not know about the problems facing his business.
Mr. Okafor is aware of the problems facing his business.
Mr. Okafor has refused to solve the problems facing his business.
Mr. Okafor is confused about his business problems.
kept.explanation: The sentence uses a double negative: 'not' + 'unaware'. Two negatives cancel out to give a positive meaning, so Mr. Okafor is indeed aware of the problems.
kept.pidgin: Dis sentence get double negative: 'not' and 'unaware'. Wen you join two negative togeda, e turn to positive, so e mean Mr. Okafor sabi di problems well well.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "Hardly had the teacher entered the class when the students began to make noise."
options: The students made noise before the teacher entered the class.
The students stopped making noise when the teacher entered.
The students began making noise soon after the teacher entered the class.
The teacher made noise before entering the class.
kept.explanation: 'Hardly... when' shows that two actions happened almost at the same time, with the second one (noise-making) following immediately after the first (teacher entering). So the noise started right after the teacher came in.
kept.pidgin: 'Hardly... when' dey show say two things happen almost same time, but di noise start immediately after teacher enter class. So di noise no come before, e come after small time.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "Had Musa studied harder, he would have passed the examination."
options: Musa studied hard and passed the examination.
Musa did not study hard, so he failed the examination.
Musa studied hard but still failed the examination.
Musa will study harder next time to pass.
kept.explanation: This is a conditional sentence (third conditional) showing an unreal past situation. Since Musa did not study harder, the implied result is that he failed the examination.
kept.pidgin: Dis na conditional sentence wey dey show something wey no happen for di past. Since Musa no study hard, e mean say e fail di exam.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "The chief's speech was nothing but empty promises."
options: The chief's speech was full of useful ideas.
The chief's speech contained only promises that will not be fulfilled.
The chief refused to make any promises in his speech.
The chief's speech was very short.
kept.explanation: 'Nothing but' means 'only'. 'Empty promises' means promises with no real intention of being kept. So the speech was made up only of promises that will likely not be fulfilled.
kept.pidgin: 'Nothing but' mean 'only'. 'Empty promises' mean promises wey no get real intention to fulfil. So di whole speech na just promises wey no go happen.

kept.q: What is the meaning of this sentence? "Were it not for the timely intervention of the police, the fight between the two communities would have escalated."
options: The police did not intervene, so the fight escalated.
The police's intervention came too late to stop the fight.
The fight escalated despite the police's intervention.
The police intervened on time and this prevented the fight from escalating.
kept.explanation: This is a conditional sentence showing a situation that did not happen because something else prevented it. The police did intervene on time, and because of that timely action, the fight did not get worse.
kept.pidgin: Dis na conditional sentence wey dey show say one thing no happen because another thing stop am. Police intervene on time, na im make di fight no escalate.
